subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word.

She is eagerly waiting for the day when she ______ to her fiancé.
solution:
The correct answer is **"gets married"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We can see that the sentence is in the present tense.
 
 
• She **is** early waiting for the day.
 
 
 
• The forthcoming clause will also be in the present tense.
 
• when we look at the options, only** gets married **is in the present tense, rest of the options are in the** other tense.**
 
• Hence, the correct sentence is: *She is eagerly waiting for the day when she **gets married** to her fiancé.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• sometimes we also use simple future after the present tense if the actions are not simultaneous.
 
 
• When he comes to the house, **he will **give us gifts.
 
• When I become a famous artist, I **will buy **a Ferrari.
